description: Receive, hours, moves: the requesting BU on site. v = fxOps.site(state) (store.view('site') with, for each unit on hire, its project segments, a grid of its days on hire up to today from store.view('hours', lineId) with the site country's weekend marked, and what each move means for the money), set by loadChain on vbEnter and on every fxRefresh. Receive, the hours (record to today, one day, approve) and the moves (breakdown, another project, another group company, lost) open a confirmation first (askChain: fxOps.ask, a dry run of the engine); Confirm runs it through actChain (fxPage.act), and a failure stays in the dialog and on the page. Return opens a dialog of its own (returnChain, fxReturn): the return date (the request's end by default, a later one is planned), the timesheet day by day (actual up to today, planned after it) and the final bill, live (estimated for a planned return); Confirm sends logHoursBulk with the actual days, then offHire. Returned units whose final timesheet is still open are listed too. Every list exports.

askDef.description: The confirmation open (fxOps.ask().def): its words and fields; kept while the fields are typed in.

form.description: The values typed in the confirmation's fields.

ask.description: fxOps.ask().preview: what EquipRite does, the money, what Fusion would do, who is told; the action and its payload.

askError.description: Why the last Confirm did not go through, in the engine's words (stays in the dialog).

failure.description: The last action that did not go through, kept on the page until dismissed or until an action works.

exportOpen.description: The list whose export menu is open.

retDef.description: The Return dialog open (fxReturn.def): its words (the request's dates, the hire's start) and the rows of the timesheet for the return date (actual up to today, planned after it; by the hour to the return day); rebuilt when the date changes, kept while hours are typed.

ret.description: What is typed in the Return dialog: the return date, the hours of use and standby by day, whether they are agreed.

retView.description: fxReturn.preview: what Confirm does (a dry run as the person played), each day's state (Planned after today), the final bill (estimated for a planned return), the payloads and the toast.

retError.description: Why the last Confirm of the Return dialog did not go through, in the engine's words.

fxRefresh.description: From the page module (fxPage.watch): the store changed, so loadChain runs again.
